title: Darren Sproles 396 Topps Gallery Serial Numbered 25/99 Composite 2024 San Diego
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Darren Sproles trading card is a must-have for any football fan. It features a beautiful composite image of Sproles in his San Diego Chargers and Los Angeles Chargers uniforms, with a serial number indicating that it is a limited edition card. The card is from the 396 Topps Gallery set and is numbered 25/99, making it a rare find for collectors.

In addition to its rarity, this card also boasts several desirable features for collectors and fans alike. It is a sports trading card that highlights Sproles' talent and contribution to the game. It is not autographed, but it still makes for a valuable addition to any collection. Don't miss out on the chance to own this unique and highly sought-after card.
